title: Obsidian shop catalog
description: The components a shop tab is built from. Components take product IDs and spec keys; prices, specs, stock and images are filled in by the app.
instructions:
- IDs, never values. Write product IDs and spec keys only. Never write a price, a spec value, a stock level or an action: the app fills them in.
- `root` is always a `Page`. Its `children` are the page's sections, in order.
- Section-level components (`Verdict`, `ProductShelf`, `SpecTable`, `ChartGrid`) are always assigned to a named variable with a short meaning-based name, such as `verdict`, `shelf`, `specs`, `colour` or `charts`, and listed by that name in `Page.children`. Never write a section inline inside `Page(...)`.
- Smaller parts (a `BarChart` inside a `ChartGrid`, an `AddToCartButton` inside a `Verdict`) are written inline.
- An `AddToCartButton` may only name a product the page shows.
- To change a page that already exists, start the block with `surface(update=true)`. Then write `root` again with its full new child list and define only the sections that are new or changed. Never repeat a section that stays as it is: naming it in `root`'s child list keeps it.

Page.description: The root of every tab. Its children are the page's sections, each one a named variable.

title.description: The page heading, up to 80 characters.

kicker.description: A short label above the title, up to 40 characters.

meta.description: Up to 4 short facts for the meta line, each up to 32 characters.

actions.description: Up to 2 buttons shown beside the title.

children.description: The sections, in order, each by its variable name (for example [verdict, shelf, specs, charts]).

ChartGrid.description: Section-level: assign it to a named variable. One or two charts side by side, written inline.

children.description: One or two BarChart components, written inline.

Verdict.description: Section-level: assign it to a named variable. The answer in one sentence, with one primary button.

lead.description: Bold opening words, usually the pick's name, up to 40 characters.

button.description: One AddToCartButton, written inline, for a product the page shows.

ProductShelf.description: Section-level: assign it to a named variable. Two to four products side by side, each with a short tag.

tag.description: Why this product is here, up to 40 characters.

items.description: Two to four products, for example [{productId: "aeris-studio-16", tag: "most power"}, ...].

pickId.description: The product ID of the pick, one of the items.

SpecTable.description: Section-level: assign it to a named variable. A spec-by-spec comparison of two to four products.

specKeys.description: Up to 12 spec keys, in the order the rows are shown.

highlightBest.description: Marks the best value in each row. Defaults to true.

BarChart.description: One numeric spec compared across two to four products. Written inline inside a ChartGrid.

title.description: The chart title, up to 60 characters.

specKey.description: A numeric spec key, such as batt, hz, p3 or de.

note.description: An optional note under the chart, up to 160 characters.

AddToCartButton.description: Adds one product to the cart. Its label and action are made by the app. Written inline as a Verdict's button or in Page.actions.

productId.description: The product ID. It must be a product the page shows.

variant.description: primary for the page's main button, ghost otherwise.

withName.description: Shows the product name in the label.

withPrice.description: Shows the price in the label.
